## Technical details

### Atom/Link

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=7a8fab62-42f7-4201-a010-52a307195847&&collection=&height=39&occurrenceKey=null&width=143&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
Props:

* text (should probably be a slot)
* href
* color

### Block/CtaBannerIntegrated

Use the ImageContrastOverlay component from <custom data-type="smartlink" data-id="id-0">https://laioutr.atlassian.net/browse/THEMES-22</custom>.

Some props:

* headline
* subline
* cta text, link, size & variant
* background image & fallback color

    * This component only has one image-prop of type `Media`. No mobile image, no focus-point props.
    
* overlay props
* colors: default/always-white/always-black for all texts

[Styling for dark-mode](https://www.notion.so/laioutr/Tips-Tricks-for-development-1835331c061e801ab7d7c68ecfff9e5f?pvs=4#1a65331c061e803880f2eab02bfb4bb9)

Further props, specific for the showcase-banner:

* Icon
* link text & href
* caption
* variant boxed/full-width (toggles container)
* Size s/xs

Pass `desktopBreakpoint="md"` to the Media component to ensure the mobile foreground/background-image is only used until md.
summary: A space-efficient call-to-action banner with icons, inline links, and compact sizing for content-heavy layouts.
features: Icon support for visual emphasis and quick recognition
Inline link display with customizable styling
Compact size options (S, XS) for secondary placements
longDescription:
## Purpose

The CTA Banner Integrated component provides a compact promotional solution for spaces where a full-sized banner would be excessive. It combines visual elements like icons with concise messaging to create effective calls-to-action that integrate naturally within content layouts without overwhelming the page design.

## Use Cases

- Secondary promotional placements alongside product listings or category pages
- In-content banners highlighting related services or cross-sell opportunities
- Compact event or sale announcements within blog posts or editorial content
- Support or documentation callouts directing users to helpful resources

## Design Rationale

The smaller sizing options (S, XS) allow this banner to fit within tighter layouts while still providing visual impact through icons and imagery. The inline link option offers a subtler call-to-action compared to prominent buttons, making it suitable for contexts where a softer promotional approach is preferred. Marketing teams can deploy these banners without disrupting the primary content flow.
